decisive_items: KDR (VEGFR2) c.C2312G, p.T771R identified as the only somatic mutation
Discrete clusters of small-caliber vessels were observed, with superficial, small lobules of small-caliber vessels. The epidermis was normal.
single, well-defined, blanchable bright red plaque densely composed of telangiectasias
response.rationale: R2 uniquely integrates the KDR somatic mutation with the bland small-vessel histology and clinical telangiectatic plaque. R6 is only descriptive and does not explain the genetic finding. R4 overreads bland lobules of small-caliber vessels as angiosarcoma and ignores the normal epidermis. R5 is contradicted by the normal epidermis and by the blanchable bright red plaque. R1 has no raw support.

rejected.why: No raw support spans are supplied; the label is not anchored to any vignette text.
The histology shows bland small lobules of small-caliber vessels with normal epidermis, not the atypical infiltrative vascular channels expected for angiosarcoma.
Angiokeratoma is contradicted by 'epidermis was normal' and by a blanchable bright red plaque; it would typically involve epidermal hyperkeratosis/acanthosis and darker non-blanchable lesions.
